# paste

Merge corresponding lines from files through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/paste names.txt values.txt

moonx cli/paste -s -d , input.txt
```

Join parallel records with tabs by default. -s processes each file serially; supplied delimiters cycle between fields.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--serial` | Join each file's records into one output record. |
| `-d VALUE`, `--delimiters VALUE` | Cycle through delimiters. |
| `-z`, `--zero-terminated` | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
